bull_bear.body:
- Leverage has risen steadily on the deck's own Debt/Equity (x) chart: FY24 0.30, FY25 0.50, FY26 0.60 - the at-a-glance slide carries "0.60X Debt to Equity" as on FY26.
- Net Worth (INR Mn) has eroded over the same period: FY24 3,325, FY25 3,040, FY26 2,709; Other Equity fell from 2,881 to 2,600 to 2,282 while Equity Share Capital stayed at 424.
- Working Capital Days improved sharply from 178 (FY24) to 157 (FY25) to 71 (FY26), alongside trade receivables falling from 1,099 (FY24) and 1,277 (FY25) to 964 (FY26) INR Mn.
- Borrowings have shifted toward the short end: current borrowings rose 459 (FY24) to 998 (FY25) to 1,160 (FY26) INR Mn while non-current borrowings eased 525 to 523 to 473; cash and cash equivalents stood at just 38 INR Mn in FY26 with other bank balances of 68.
- Capital deployment appears paused rather than expansionary - Capital WIP is 1 (FY24) and nil in FY25 and FY26, and FY26 shows "Assets Classified as held for sale" of 43 INR Mn, consistent with the natural stone unit closure.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Global Surfaces Limited (GSL), established in 1991 and headquartered in Jaipur, India, specializes in the production and export of natural stones and engineered quartz products"; the at-a-glance slide claims "20+ Years of experience", "550+ Total workforce", "2 State-of-the-art manufacturing facilities In India and Dubai" and "95% Exports" (all figures stated as on FY26).
- The tagline is "Built for Scale, powered by Cutting-Edge Technology"; leadership is Managing Director and Chairperson Mr. Mayank Shah, "who has more than 2 decades of experience in the stones industry".
- Geographic revenue is overwhelmingly export-facing - FY26 break-up shown as Export 95% / Domestic 5% - with export countries listed as USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE, Europe and Kuwait.
- The deck frames dual-shore manufacturing as a resilience moat: Global Surfaces FZE "Strengthens supply chain resilience through dual-shore manufacturing" and "Utilizes exclusive technology licenses for producing patented engineered quartz in the MENA region".
- Growth drivers named are rising demand for aesthetic and durable surfaces, urbanization and infrastructure growth, "Rising exports to developed nations and tariffs on Chinese quartz increasing opportunities for Indian manufacturers", and technological advancement in customized/AI-driven manufacturing.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Plant closure] "The Board of Directors at its meeting held on Feb 3, 2026, has approved discontinuation of operations at Company's Natural Stone Unit situated at Industrial Area Bagru, Jaipur, effective from March 31, 2026. Post March 31, 2026, only limited activities were carried out for orderly closure of existing orders."
- [US distribution] Global Surfaces Inc. (GSI), wholly owned, was incorporated April 20, 2020 in Delaware to purchase, sell, supply and distribute quartz, marble, granite and other natural and engineered stones across the United States, giving "a direct presence in key international markets - particularly North America".
- [JV consolidation] Superior Surfaces Inc. (SSI) was incorporated May 5, 2023 in Texas as a strategic joint venture; "Global Surfaces Limited holds a 50% equity stake and maintains board-level and key policy control, classifying SSI as a subsidiary within the Group structure", distributing artificial stones (primarily engineered quartz) in the US.
- [Revenue mix shift] Q1-FY27 commentary states "UAE operations emerged as the largest revenue contributor, reflecting the successful ramp-up of the FZE facility and strengthening the Company's geographic revenue mix", alongside expansion of domestic presence "through a dedicated sales team, stronger dealer and distributor engagement... reducing dependence on export markets".
- [Shareholding & market data, as on 30th June 2026] Promoter 73.25%, Public 25.99%, FII 0.76%, DII 0.00%; Face Value INR 10.0, CMP 42.00, 52 Week H/L 139.9/41.9, Market Cap INR 1,780.0 Mn, Shares O/S 42.4 Mn, Avg. Vol. 215.7 ('000).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Global Surfaces Limited as an export-led, dual-shore engineered quartz manufacturer - India SEZ plus a Jebel Ali Free Zone plant in Dubai - that has exited natural stone manufacturing and is pivoting to patented, premium licensed quartz technology (Marquartz) with its own US distribution arms.
